meta.title: BIZBOT | بِزبط — Smart POS & operations system for restaurants and businesses
meta.description: BIZBOT (بِزبط) is one integrated system to run your restaurant or business: POS, Kitchen Display (KDS), self-service kiosks and a reporting dashboard — multi-device, trilingual, and it keeps selling even when the internet drops.

hero.title: Smarter restaurant operations, faster service and clearer visibility
hero.subtitle: From order to kitchen to reporting, POS, KDS, kiosk and dashboard work as one connected system.
hero.deviceAlt: The BIZBOT point-of-sale screen showing the menu grid and the order cart
hero.kdsAlt: The BIZBOT kitchen display showing tickets by status
hero.sceneAlt: A BIZBOT restaurant workstation showing the point-of-sale station and connected service devices

products.title: Four modules. One system.
products.subtitle: Four modules move each order through one flow, from customer to management.

items.title: Point of Sale (POS)
items.desc: Orders, tables, takeaway, payment and printing in one clear counter interface.
items.alt: The point-of-sale screen inside a counter terminal next to a thermal receipt printer
items.chip: New ticket sent to the kitchen

items.title: Kitchen Display (KDS)
items.desc: Kitchen tickets organised by status, with clearer prep details and totals for the team.
items.alt: The kitchen display inside a dark kitchen screen

items.title: Self-service kiosks
items.desc: Visual self-ordering with table or takeaway selection, sent directly into the system.
items.alt: An upright self-service kiosk showing the welcome screen

items.title: Reports & operations
items.desc: Sales, orders, staff and devices in one dashboard that gives management a clearer view.
items.alt: The reports dashboard inside a tablet

journey.title: Watch an order move through BIZBOT
journey.subtitle: Scroll and follow a single order from the moment it is placed until it reaches the dashboard.

steps.title: The customer orders
steps.desc: At the kiosk on their own, or through the cashier at the POS.

steps.title: The POS takes it
steps.desc: The order is recorded, paid when needed, and the receipt and kitchen ticket print.

steps.title: The kitchen prepares
steps.desc: The ticket appears on the kitchen screen right away and moves between states.

steps.title: The order is ready
steps.desc: The ticket is marked ready and the order is handed to the customer.

steps.title: Management sees the picture
steps.desc: The order and the sales show up in the dashboard as they happen.

story.title: From scattered handoffs to connected operations
story.subtitle: BIZBOT connects the order, kitchen, readiness and management in one clearer flow for the team.

items.problem: Orders get scattered between the cashier and the kitchen
items.solution: POS and KDS connect the order straight to the kitchen

items.problem: A crowded counter slows service down
items.solution: The kiosk lets customers order by themselves

items.problem: The owner can't see the full picture
items.solution: The dashboard brings orders, sales and management into one place

items.problem: Order mistakes eat the team's time
items.solution: A clear flow from the order to the kitchen to ready

features.title: Features that make the difference
features.subtitle: Everything the team needs for a clearer flow, sharper oversight and easier daily operations.

items.title: Order management
items.desc: Tables and takeaway from one screen, with the live status of every order.

items.title: Reports & analytics
items.desc: Today's sales, best-selling items and payments — clear numbers that support decisions.

items.title: Menu management
items.desc: Manage categories, items, prices and modifiers from the dashboard, tied to branches and permissions.

items.title: Staff management
items.desc: A personal account per employee with a PIN, role-based permissions and a full activity log.

items.title: Multilingual
items.desc: Arabic, English and Hebrew end to end — interfaces and receipts that respect text direction.

items.title: Fits many business types
items.desc: Restaurants, cafés, sweets, fast food, cloud kitchens… the same system.

items.title: Easy to use
items.desc: A clear, simple interface that shortens the learning curve and makes team training easier.

items.title: Multi-device
items.desc: Runs on counter terminals, tablets, kitchen screens, kiosks and the browser.

items.title: Smart kitchen flow
items.desc: Tickets reach the kitchen the moment they are sent, with prep totals — fewer mistakes, more speed.

items.title: Fast setup
items.desc: Clear setup and quick device pairing so you start operating in as few steps as possible.

items.title: Resilient operation
items.desc: The counter keeps selling if the internet drops and syncs automatically when it returns.

items.title: Performance tracking
items.desc: Branch readiness, devices and open orders at a glance from the dashboard.

statement.brandLine: More than a POS — a partner in your success.

business.title: Built for different food businesses
business.subtitle: Restaurants, cafés, sweets, fast food and cloud kitchens — one system shaped around how you work.

items.title: Restaurants
items.desc: Tables, floor maps and a synced kitchen.

items.title: Cafés
items.desc: Quick orders at the counter or the kiosk.

items.title: Sweets & desserts

items.title: Fast food

items.title: Cloud kitchens

items.title: And more

why.title: Built for the busiest day of the week
why.subtitle: Reliability, permissions, printing and resilient operation designed for real restaurant work, not just a demo.

items.title: Works offline
items.desc: The counter keeps taking and printing orders during an outage and syncs everything automatically when the network is back.

items.title: Layered security
items.desc: A personal identity for every employee, paired and authorised devices, and role-based permissions — no shared passwords.

items.title: Multi-branch from day one
items.desc: One venue or a chain — the same system, with reports per branch or across all of them.

items.title: Thermal printing, ready
items.desc: Receipts and kitchen tickets on the usual thermal printers, in Arabic, Hebrew and English.

items.title: A complete activity log
items.desc: Every sensitive action is recorded: who, when and from which device — full transparency for the owner.

items.title: Continuous development, close support
items.desc: Regular updates across all modules, and support that understands how restaurants and shops really work.
